opportunities.name: Rear-shiv hybrid finish
opportunities.objective: Test an AP attack packet before a rear-facing low-health shiv.
opportunities.mechanic: Backstab adds AP-scaled magic damage to rear E, enhanced below 30% health, and E itself has both AP and AD[statFormula=2] magic scaling. Lich Bane and Nashor supply real attack damage while Q enables the angle; Shadowflame targets the magic finish below 40%. W provides a fear window rather than assumed inherited on-hits.
opportunities.requiredState: Q reaches the rear, target drops below 30%, and Spellblade is ready for the actual attack.
opportunities.failure: The target turns or shields above the threshold; AP sacrifices the physical Q opening.
opportunities.test: Separate rear attack/Q, E and passive rear-E packets above/below 30% health.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Q forced crit follows its special formula, not an unrestricted ordinary crit multiplier.

opportunities.name: Invisible box staging
opportunities.objective: Keep Q invisibility while placing W and R to prepare a delayed area trap.
opportunities.mechanic: Q explicitly permits W and R without breaking invisibility. W takes two seconds to stealth and fires for five seconds once triggered; R detonation spawns mini boxes. AP supports those magic packets and Liandry/Bloodletter test burn and debuff application; Cosmic rewards confirmed magic contact for repositioning.
opportunities.requiredState: Record box placement, arm time, clone lifetime and target movement through a prepared area.
opportunities.failure: Enemies reveal or avoid boxes; clone dies out of range and setup time loses map pressure.
opportunities.test: Observe invisibility after W/R, then count box hits, burn refresh and MR debuff stacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Boxes and clone are not automatically carriers of every owner item effect.

ruledOut.reason: R states clone damage fraction but does not establish inheritance of Spellblade, item cooldowns or all attack procs.

unknowns: Pet burn/Bloodletter and clone inheritance need live logs. E/Q AD flags and Q crit conversion are retained.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The target turns or shields above the threshold; AP sacrifices the physical Q opening.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Q forced crit follows its special formula, not an unrestricted ordinary crit multiplier.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
